digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill Step 7 and plan-review gate documentation
propositions: Step 7 does not declare confirmed sibling bugs as scope on the ticket, so fixes for individual siblings are never reviewed as a design for the family.

The plan-review escalation system exists (bug_blast_radius_escalates in orchestrator.py) but Step 7 does not reference or invoke it, leaving sibling classes to be reviewed at the light bug tier rather than the full rubric.
docs/plan-review-gate.md contradicts the shipped blast-radius escalation by stating a bug can never be BLOCKED and is never escalated out of the advisory tier.

Step 7 must route confirmed siblings through the existing Phase-1 review-plan directive by declaring file impact and running rebar review-plan before Phase 2 continues, but this integration is not currently documented.

Each confirmed sibling must become its own acceptance-criteria checkbox on the bug ticket with a construct-uniqueness guard criterion, making the class-level plan reviewable as a declared scope change.
